BlackThriveSS: Reproducible Dashboard Evidence

Source: R/BlackThriveSS-package.R
BlackThriveSS-package.Rd

Start with btg_get_data() and btg_plot_disparity(). Inspect provenance with btg_metadata(), reporting coverage with btg_coverage(), and chart values with btg_figure_data(). Use btg_save_view() and btg_from_view() to replay the original evidence specification offline. Inspect internal consistency with btg_validate(). The installed tutorial is available through vignette("getting-started", package = "BlackThriveSS").
